purpose: Resolve every INCLUDED_RAW_IDENTITY_PENDING adapter from the frozen full-static provider qualification before any Binance route check. Mapping is based on adapter/project/token identity only and must not change after route results are observed.

quarantined_adapters.stella.ts: IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS_FAIL_CLOSED: adapter project identity and token contract metadata were not promoted to a Binance symbol mapping in this freeze. Exclude before route check rather than infer post-result.

identity_rules.liquity_2023_quarantine_reason: 2023 snapshot token metadata is LUSD while the vesting schedule is treated as LQTY elsewhere; do not silently relabel ambiguous rows.
identity_rules.cross_snapshot_deduplication: same symbol + exact timestamp + exact amount -> keep earliest immutable known_at authority and retain later snapshot as corroboration
identity_rules.cross_snapshot_conflict: same symbol + exact timestamp + differing amount -> SOURCE_CONFLICT and exclude all conflicting rows
